proof_body:
by
  intro f a u hf hu
  have h := Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff.1 (hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO.1 hf) (half_pos hu)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hd⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 h
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x => ⟨fun h1 h2 => ?_, fun h1 h2 => ?_⟩⟩
  · have h3 := hd (y := x) (by rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith)
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul] at h3
    rw [abs_of_pos (show 0 < x - a by linarith)] at h3
    have h4 := (abs_le.1 h3).1
    nlinarith [sub_pos.2 h1]
  · have h3 := hd (y := x) (by rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith)
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul] at h3
    rw [abs_of_neg (show x - a < 0 by linarith)] at h3
    have h4 := (abs_le.1 h3).2
    nlinarith [sub_pos.2 h2]
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a u : ℝ), HasDerivAt f u a → 0 < u → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, (a < x → x < a + δ → f a < f x) ∧ (a - δ < x → x < a → f x < f a)
